The same model with Perplexity's web search off is Perplexity Decider 27B v1.2 · API: Web grounding compares the two.

27B dense, as the maker states it (counted from the released files: 26.09B). language model (no LM head) + 0.46B vision encoder + 255-way readout; source: counted from the checkpoint's safetensors, perplexity-ai/pplx-decider-v1.2@225c913 (the same weights as cce0f3f), huggingface.co/perplexity-ai/pplx-decider-v1.2; read 9 November 2026

Perplexity's hosted Decider v1.2 through its Decisions API with web grounding on: a web search per question, its results added as evidence. The search sends the question out, and for some questions it returned pages of the bank's source book (the Web grounding page). Its cost is an upper-bound estimate: one $0.001 search billed per request, while Perplexity bills only completed searches.

Latency: the time from sending one request to receiving its answer, measured from our computer, network and any retries within the request included. Request time: the time at least one request was in flight, over the requests whose answers were kept. It is not the run's elapsed time: it leaves out requests that failed and any pause before a run was resumed.
